scenarios.task: This thread runs in the repository's primary checkout, which is on main and clean. The user asks you to fix a typo in an error message and open a PR.

options.branch-here: create a branch in this checkout with git switch -c, then make the fix
options.worktree: move the work to a new worktree on a new branch, then make the fix
options.ask: ask the user where to make the change

scenarios.task: This thread runs in the repository's primary checkout, which is on main and clean. The user asks how the config loader resolves environment overrides.

options.answer: read the code in this checkout and answer
options.worktree: move the thread to a new worktree first, then read the code and answer

scenarios.task: This thread runs in a worktree that T3 Code created for it, on its own branch made from the latest main. The user asks you to fix a typo in an error message and open a PR.

options.fix-here: make the fix on this branch in this worktree
options.new-worktree: move the work to another new worktree, then make the fix
